description: This file declares low-level internal ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) functions, constants, structures, and macros used for hardware ADC input processing within the project. It includes function prototypes for initializing ADC inputs, retrieving ADC channel information, waiting for ADC conversions, and printing reports, with conditional compilation based on HAL_USE_ADC.

classes.name: adc_state
classes.description: Structure holding a snapshot of ADC data for multiple channels, including an array of ADC samples.

methods.name: getAdcMode
methods.description: Returns a string describing the mode of the specified hardware ADC channel.

methods.name: initAdcInputs
methods.description: Initializes ADC inputs, optionally in test mode.

methods.name: adc_callback_fast
methods.description: Fast callback function for ADC conversions, likely called upon completion of ADC sampling.

methods.name: getAdcChannelPin
methods.description: Returns the microcontroller pin associated with a given ADC hardware channel (deprecated).

methods.name: getAdcChannelPort
methods.description: Returns the I/O port associated with a given ADC hardware channel (deprecated).

methods.name: getAdcChannel
methods.description: Provides the ADC channel associated with a specific brain pin.

methods.name: getAdcChannelBrainPin
methods.description: Returns the brain pin associated with a given ADC channel.

methods.name: waitForSlowAdc
methods.description: Blocks until at least one slow ADC sampling is complete.

methods.name: getSlowAdcCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of completed slow ADC samples.

methods.name: getAdcHardwareIndexByInternalIndex
methods.description: Maps an internal ADC index to its hardware-specific index.

methods.name: printFullAdcReportIfNeeded
methods.description: Outputs a detailed ADC report if configured to do so.

methods.name: getInternalAdcValue
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ADC value with an optional message prefix.

methods.name: getMCUInternalTemperature
methods.description: Returns the MCU's internal temperature as a float.
